'''J'pai Brek''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilot]] coordinator who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
J'pai Brek was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
